notes: Version B (4x/8x cluster highlighted) of Figure 1. Figure 1. Histograms of the per-site ratio of ERA5-derived mean annual precipitation (MAP) to two independent references, 781 current-network sites. Left panel: ERA5/BIO12 (n=780; excludes 1 site with era5_map_mm == 0, undefined on a log axis: CA-TP2). Right panel: ERA5/BADM (n=631; excludes 150 sites: 144 with no BADM value, 5 with BADM MAP == 0, and the same 1 site with era5_map_mm == 0). X-axis is log10(ratio); bin width 0.1 log10 units (~26% per bin); axis range is not clipped and extends to the full observed range in each panel, so the single most extreme site in each panel appears in its own bin. Dashed reference lines at ratio = 1x, 4x, 8x. Version B: the 123 sites in the 4x/8x cluster are shown in a second colour; see legend for the membership rule.
